sources.title: Smart MCQ Solver - a Hugging Face Space by 23f3003672
sources.snippet: A DeBERTa-v3-small cross-encoder, fine-tuned with LoRA on the Smart MCQ Solver Challenge dataset. Enter a question and five candidate answers; the model scores all five jointly and returns them ranked, along with the top-three string the competition's mAP@3 metric is scored on.

sources.title: GitHub - srthkdev/smart-mcq-demo
sources.snippet: smart mcq solver - live demo a browser demo of the fine-tuned deberta-v3-small model from my dl genai project. type a science multiple choice question with five options and it predicts the correct one, showing the probability for each and the top-3 ranked answer.

sources.snippet: 📌 Project Overview Smart MCQ Solver is an intelligent Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) answering system developed as part of the BSDA2001P Deep Learning and Generative AI course project.

sources.title: Smart MCQ Solver
sources.snippet: Expect them to get novel questions wrong; that is the finding, not a bug. DeBERTa-v3-large is the model that actually answers. DeBERTa downloads a 1.7 GB base model on its first query — allow a minute.
